titre: Classer les emails reçus : lead entrant, partenariat, prospection reçue, presse, autre
description: Tout ce qui arrive dans la boîte de contact ou celle du dirigeant passe devant Jev, qui range chaque email dans une case : les leads entrants filent au commercial, les propositions de partenariat et de presse à la personne qui décide, la prospection reçue et l'administratif s'archivent sans lecture. Les catégories sont celles d'une boîte de dirigeant de PME de services : ajoutez ou retirez des cases selon ce que vous recevez.

categorie.instructions: An email arrived in the inbox of a small B2B company: `expediteur` is the sender address or name, `objet` the subject, `corps` the body. Which category does it belong to? Decide on what the sender wants from us.

criteria.lead_entrant: A prospect or a client asks about our services, prices, availability, a quote, a call, or follows up on a form they filled on our site.
criteria.partenariat: Another company proposes to work together: referral deal, co-marketing, joint webinar, integration, reselling, event sponsorship, affiliation.
criteria.prospection_recue: Someone tries to sell us something we did not ask for: a tool, an agency, outsourcing, leads, SEO, recruiting services, a 'quick question' cold email ending with a pitch.
criteria.presse: A journalist, podcast host, event organizer or newsletter editor asks for an interview, a quote, a talk, a contribution or a comment.
criteria.candidature: A person applies for a job or an internship, sends a CV, or asks whether we are hiring.
criteria.administratif: Invoices, payment reminders, bank, accountant, insurance, tax office, legal notices, tool notifications, subscription renewals.
criteria.autre: Newsletters, personal messages, spam without a pitch, or an email too short to decide.
